theorem bbolt.dropBkt_ofC (c : bbolt.TxViewC) (n : GoString) : (bbolt.TxView.ofC c).dropBkt n =
    bbolt.TxView.ofC (bbolt.dropC c n)

def bbolt.dropC (c : bbolt.TxViewC) (n : GoString) : bbolt.TxViewC :=
  (c.fst, c.snd.fst, GMap.delete n c.snd.snd.fst, <[n := (c.snd.snd.snd !! n).getD 0 + 1]>c.snd.snd.snd)
